## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 24, 2026 - Oct 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Shay Shay1983_, Oct 3, 2026, 1/5: "I wanted to see what the workouts would be like so I accepted the offer for the free trial. Two days later, I canceled the free trial and 1 month later they are STILL attempting to charge my card $95 all throughout the night. I keep my cards blocked so it wasn’t successful but the fact that they’re still attempting to bill is mind boggling"
            2. _re ggie_, Sep 29, 2026, 1/5: "I decided not to proceed with a subscription with this app because when trying to look over MY PLAN, I noticed no actual plan/account information with options to continue or cancel. Also, its not in my apple subscriptions. Very odd to me. So I went into my email, only to find it in my SPAM, they stated it will auto-renew with my card. When trying to click the link to cancel auto-renew, it doesn't work! Sent an email to support, "PLEASE DO NOT AUTO-RENEW". Never has an app subscription been so difficult to cancel."
            3. _Upset user45552_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "I Used It For One Day And Got A Trainer So I Canceled My Subscription And They’re Still Trying To Take A Payment Of $96 From My Account ."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jan 24, 2026 - Oct 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _tmac66_, Oct 2, 2026, 1/5: "Filled with bugs and glitches this app needs a lot of work. I get the feeling this thing was thrown together overnight. If you’re a beginner be very careful because this app does not guide you as it should. It doesn’t ask if you have any medical issues such as rotator cuff bad back or any following type of injuries that would potentially prevent you from doing certain exercises. I have found that it adds sets. I had one exercise were it had me doing it 10 times."
            2. _mo4958589594_, Jan 24, 2026, 2/5: "The app has so much potential but is so broken. It alerts me on the wrong days, it does a ludicrous amount of reps and weight for where I’m at in my fitness ability, it will give me 6 exercises for my biceps in one day when my split is meant to be full body every work out. It COULD be great, but it’s not there. I won’t be renewing my subscription"
            3. _East County Mom_, Sep 23, 2026, 3/5: "App glitches more often than not. Workouts don’t always feel like they flow well together."
<!--/ir-theme-->
